**What happened**
<!-- The command or rule you ran, and what it did. -->

**What you expected**
<!-- What should have happened instead. -->

**How to reproduce**
<!-- A minimal Galaxy tool XML (inline or a link) and the exact command, for

**Behaviour-preservation note (if a fix changed behaviour)**
<!-- If `format` or `upgrade` changed what the tool DOES, not just how it reads,

     (docs/behavior_preservation.md), so a reproducible counter-example is valuable. -->

**Environment**
<!-- galaxy-tool-refactor version or commit, Python version, and OS. -->
